## Comments near the code
- BookingService.handlePaymentResult: Applies a PuckPay payment result. Idempotent; late payments do not revive released bookings.
- SessionService.effectiveCapacity: Capacity after club bookings: halved if one half is taken, zero if the whole rink is.
- ReportService.weekly: Report for the Monday-to-Sunday week containing `date`.
- ReportService.range: Report for an arbitrary inclusive date range (e.g. a whole season).
- IceMonitorService: Watches ice temperature and manages sessions put on hold because the ice is too warm.
- IceMonitorService.recordReading: Records a sensor reading; holds the next session once the ice has been warm for long enough.
- IceMonitorService.cancel: Manager cancels a held session: every paid ticket is refunded through PuckPay.
- IceMonitorService.release: Manager lifts the hold; ticket sales resume.
- IceMonitorService.warmLongEnough: True when the readings end in a run of warm readings spanning at least ten minutes.
- IceMonitorService.nextSession: The earliest session that has not started yet.

capabilities.description: Customers book tickets and skate hire for public sessions, subject to availability and the members' monthly free-skate allowance. Bookings are priced and paid through PuckPay checkout, payment results are applied idempotently, and unpaid bookings expire.
capabilities.name: Public skate ticket booking and payment

capabilities.description: New rink sessions are validated and scheduled, and ticket and hire-equipment availability is calculated. Effective capacity shrinks when clubs book half or all of the rink.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and capacity management

capabilities.description: Clubs book the rink without overlapping other bookings, club bookings are recorded and listed, and a monthly invoice is produced for each club.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Session sales and occupancy are reported for a week or an arbitrary date range such as a season, with CSV export.
capabilities.name: Sales and occupancy reporting

capabilities.description: Ice temperature is monitored, and the next session is put on hold when the ice has been warm for long enough, with ticket holders notified. Managers can cancel a held session, refunding paid tickets through PuckPay, or release it so ticket sales resume.
capabilities.name: Ice condition monitoring and session hold management
